notes: Patterns are modelled on what gets the most plays. Every word Julian publishes is his own: never copy another teacher's title, script or signature lines.
Insight Timer titles: no category words (Guided Meditation, Meditation, Music) and no teacher name. Spotify titles: lead with the format keyword, then the benefit.
Insight Timer pays a play after 120 seconds and pays a return rate bonus (25 to 30% of teacher income). Hook early, invite a return tomorrow, offer a range of lengths, upload regularly.
Insight Timer requires a real human voice for narration. Voice clones and text to speech are not permitted. Use Record mode for anything going to Insight Timer.

formats.name: Yoga Nidra for Sleep
formats.evidence: Strong. The single most played track on Insight Timer is a 22 minute yoga nidra for sleep (about 23.5M plays). Yoga nidra has its own Sleep category.
beats: Settle into stillness and set a simple heartfelt resolve
Rotate awareness through the body, point by point, unhurried
Count the breath backwards, losing count is welcome
Pairs of opposite sensations: heavy and light, warm and cool
A few quick, quiet images
Let go into sleep. No bell, no waking up, long silences to the end

formats.evidence: Moderate. Return rate counts listeners who come back the next day, so a daily morning ritual feeds it directly. Popular daily tracks run about 12 minutes. Built on the Living Awake Daily Practice.

Five conscious breaths, counted on the breath. Losing count is not failure, noticing is the return
